age.evidence: Male Wistar rats (Charles River), ranging from 350 to 500 g

sex.evidence: Male Wistar rats (Charles River), ranging from 350 to 500 g, were individually housed

dosing.evidence: 4-AcO-DMT ... was dissolved in 0.9 % sodium chloride (saline) and administered intraperitoneally (i.p.). The conditioning phase consisted of four sessions (procedures D and W) or eight sessions (B procedure) of 40 min each.

group_housing.evidence: Male Wistar rats ... were individually housed in Plexiglas cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-hour light cycle (7:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M.)... All place conditioning and tests were conducted between 08:30 and 19:00 h.

assays.assay_description: Unbiased, counterbalanced place conditioning in two distinct wooden environments (41 × 41 × 38 cm; white/wire mesh vs black/Plexiglas) separated by a neutral gray area. Three conditioning procedures (B: drug vs saline 24 h later; D: drug vs non-paired; W: 24-h withdrawal vs non-paired) with 4-AcO-DMT 2, 4, 10 mg/kg i.p.; 40-min conditioning sessions; 10-min drug-free test ≥48 h after last injection. Outcome: preference index.

setup_habituation.evidence: The pre-exposure phase involved a single 20-minute session in separate wooden boxes (41 × 41 × 38 cm) painted gray with a gray floor

setup_restrain.evidence: each rat was placed in the neutral gray area ... and could explore both environments freely for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: Free access to food in home cage ('during the entire experiment'); no food described in the test apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: Free access to water in home cage; no water described in the test apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: Testing was performed in a drug-free state, at least 2 days after the final conditioning session; the preference test was done at least 48 h after the last injection

sample_size.evidence: n = 8 per group; F(3,28) for each procedure; two control groups (one for B, one shared for D and W)

outcomes.summary: In the standard counterbalanced procedure (B), 4 mg/kg 4-AcO-DMT produced place aversion vs saline control while 2 and 10 mg/kg had no effect. In the acute-only procedure (D), 2 mg/kg produced place preference; in the withdrawal-only procedure (W), the 24-h aftereffect of 2 and 4 mg/kg produced place preference. 10 mg/kg had no effect in any procedure.
outcomes.statistics: Control comparison t(14, 28) = 0.57, p > 0.05; Procedure B: F(3,28) = 5.48, P < 0.05, Tukey 4 mg/kg vs control P < 0.05; Procedure D: F(3,28) = 5.48, P < 0.05, Tukey 2 mg/kg vs control P < 0.05; Procedure W: F(3,28) = 4.81, P < 0.05, Tukey 2 and 4 mg/kg vs control P < 0.05
outcomes.evidence: (B) 4-AcO-DMT (4 mg/kg) induced aversion (*p < 0.05), while 2 and 10 mg/kg had no effect. (C) 4-AcO-DMT (2 mg/kg) induced reward (*p < 0.05), while 4 and 10 mg/kg had no effect. (D) Withdrawal from 4-AcO-DMT (2 and 4 mg/kg) induced reward (*p < 0.05), while 10 mg/kg had no effects.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The preference index for each animal was calculated by subtracting the time spent in the saline-paired environment from the time spent in the drug-paired environment, divided by the total time and multiplied by 100

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single preference index over the 10-min test; no within-session analysis

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Only time in compartments (spatial preference) measured

B5_social.evidence: Individual rat tested in place conditioning apparatus

B6_cognitive.evidence: The conditioned place preference paradigm is a well-established model utilized to investigate the role of context associations in reward-related behaviors

B8_multivariate.evidence: One-way ANOVA per procedure on preference index

E1_environment_type.evidence: two distinct wooden environments (41 × 41 × 38 cm) that differed in color, texture, and smell

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed refuge described in CPP apparatus

E3_bedding.evidence: One environment was white with a wire mesh floor, and the other was black with a smooth Plexiglas floor

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material described in apparatus

E6_spatial.evidence: the neutral gray (#788199) area (41 × 10 cm) that separated the two wooden compartments

E7_social_context.evidence: each rat was placed in the neutral gray area ... and could explore both environments freely for 10 min

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in test apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: The preference place employed in this study was unbiased ... and devoid of any test session before conditioning; test lasted 10 min

D2_session_duration.evidence: could explore both environments freely for 10 min

judge_notes: Merged deepseek4's three CPP entries (Procedures B, D, W) into a single CPP assay: same apparatus, same 10-min test, same preference-index outcome; procedures differ only in conditioning schedule.
Excluded VTA BDNF Western blot (ex vivo molecular work).
B1 scored 0: only the preference index is reported as a result; gemma4's score of 1 with value '1' was internally inconsistent and deepseek4's 'implicit' compartment times are not reported.
D1/D3/D4 scored 0: the paper states the procedure was 'devoid of any test session before conditioning'; the 20-min pre-exposure in separate gray boxes had no reported data.
D5 scored 1 (overriding gemma4): test was ≥48 h after last injection.
time_to_assay binned as short_term_1to7d (2880 min); candidates' early_2to24h and long_term_over7d bins were inconsistent with the stated ≥48 h.
n_total = 88 assumes 32 animals in B (incl. control) plus 24 drug-treated each in D and W plus one shared 8-animal control for D/W, per 'two control groups'; medium confidence.
setup_habituation kept as 'yes' (modal) at medium confidence since pre-exposure was in separate gray boxes rather than the conditioning apparatus itself.
